data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate made a profit of $12.4 (2015: loss of $33.0) of which $17.1 was attributable to prior years.
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding reduced versus the prior year; the Managing Agent reports a profit of $12.4m for 2016 of which $17.1m related to prior years (a release). The reported prior-year improvement is presented as a contribution to the 2016 result (net figure disclosed); no explicit gross prior-year movement figure was located in the technical reserves movement note on the pages available.
raw_causal_phrases: of which $17.1 was attributable to prior years.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction from scanned images. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (comparative column 2015 = 457.8) - confidence moderate (visual read). The only explicit prior-year amount found in the Managing Agent's Report is '$17.1 attributable to prior years' (used here), but that sentence appears to state a contribution to the overall result (i.e. a NET figure after reinsurance). No clear gross (insurance liabilities) 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was identifiable in the visible notes; therefore a net prior-year release of $17.1m has been used and flagged. Segmental premium class names and a full gross claims development triangle were not unambiguously extracted from the images; these fields are left empty. Numbers are in the report's native currency (USD millions).
